key_insight: A general-purpose language model can directly write small neural-network weights that rank material candidates without property labels and improve early-stage discovery.
engineering_relevance: These label-free predictors can initialize Bayesian optimization and screen generated crystals when experimental or simulation data are scarce.
method: Provide the language model with a task description, input names, and a zero-initialized network with 16 hidden units.
Have it fill in all network weights directly as text.
Use the resulting predictor for ranking, as a Bayesian model's prior mean, or for screening generated crystals.
evidence_signal: Zero-label Spearman correlations reached 0.64–0.79 on experimental alloys and 0.95 on generated crystals; Bayesian optimization regret improved significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks.
watch_item: Benefits are concentrated in the first tens of labels and in targets not already well ranked by simple rules or subsystem extrapolation.
